notes.title: ver.1.0.5
notes.content:
Added modes X-NORMAL and X-HARD that have different game rules from the previous game.
When continuing, the gauge will return to half on all difficulty levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015869/8adf8ceb3be710b7db1c167a75436e33ccaf60f9.jpg[/img]
*Differences between X-mode and conventional modes
When the light blue gauge is at 1/6, you can hold one shield, and when the gauge is at half, you can hold one more, for a maximum of two shields (X-HARD is half and only one).
When hit with a shield, the gauge does not decrease, and you cannot gain additional shields unless you decrease the gauge by activating a hyper or losing your ship.
When you activate a hyper while holding a shield, you get a bonus of 10,000 points (X-NORMAL is 10,000 points with 2 shields remaining, 1,000 points with 1 shield remaining).
When not in hyper mode, the light blue gauge rises when you shoot at an enemy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015869/844931b3178e07d24ed7deef702819cd5713337c.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ver.1.0.4
notes.content:

notes.title: ver.1.0.3
notes.content:
Energy increase during Hyper has been increased to 1.2 times the previous amount.
Slightly expand bit defense judgment.
Displays the ship's speed only when the speed changes every time the button is pressed.
Changed to start with maximum energy in stage select from the second stage onwards.
Fixed issue where enemy bullets from the stage 4 boss could not be erased with bits.
Pink enemy bullets will now disappear when hit by terrain (only pure terrain other than moving walls, etc.)
Change the battleship BGM in stage 3 (you can also return to the original BGM from SETTING)
Fixed some display priority mistakes.

notes.title: ver.1.0.2
notes.content:
Added button for slow movement
You can select to move at low speed while pressing the button, and switch between low speed and normal speed each time you press the button.

(Requires button settings in the key configuration and settings in the LOW SPEED section of SETTING)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015869/d9240fa0467cd32de7b5a075c50db96a117a6943.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015869/57e77408508a3ab4ee265b626ae674483e630f46.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ver.1.0.1
notes.content:
Changed so that invincibility time will occur for 3 seconds immediately after hyper activation.

Changed so that an afterimage will occur when the 3rd stage boss moves at high speed.
(The afterimage has a defense judgment and its damage is added to the boss. There is no attack judgment on the player side)

*With this update, replays of previous versions will no longer be consistent.
